summary_en: Acquisition frame and share purchase limit expanded. Previous limit and new limit not fully legible in PDF excerpt; execution period August 2024 to [month/year not fully visible]. Method and price ceiling not disclosed in excerpt.
title_en: Notice regarding changes to matters related to acquisition of treasury shares (expansion of acquisition frame)
translation_en_brief: J Trust Co., Ltd. announced on 8 August 2024 that its board of directors has resolved to revise the terms of an ongoing treasury share acquisition programme. The revision expands both the maximum number of shares to be acquired and the total acquisition budget. The rationale is to enable opportunistic repurchases in response to current market conditions. Specific numerical limits, price ceiling, and revised execution window end-date are present in the filing but not fully legible in the first two pages provided. The acquisition remains under the framework of the Companies Act Article 156(3), and shares outstanding excluding treasury (as of 7 July 2024) were listed for reference.
